_comment: How long things are kept. Three buckets, because the only question anyone actually asks a document is whether it can go yet, and disks are cheap while a missing paper is not. Anything a real rule would put at one or two years goes in the four-year bucket, anything above ten years is kept for good. Zanmai puts this in front of the user once and what they confirm lands in zanmai/retention.json, which is the file Zanmai reads.

terms.label: Kept for good
terms.why: Cannot be reissued, or proves something with no end date: certificates, diplomas, medical findings, proof of ownership, payslips, court decisions

terms.label: Ten years
terms.why: Money and contracts: invoices, bank statements, anything behind a tax return, insurance, tenancy, work on the property

terms.label: Four years
terms.why: Everyday proof with no contract behind it: receipts, orders, warranties on small things
